text:
leah: Hey @sam @jordan @maria — pinging for quick eyes on PR #36211. It changes KV fallback routing + adds an eviction header opt-in. We need runtime + infra + security sign-off before trying a Wed morning canary (aiming for Wed 10:00am PT). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/36211 :eyes:

sam: quick skim — looks like the eviction header is added to the agent side and a small TTL bump. Do we have perf runs? worried about 99p tail with small seqs.

leah: perf runs attached in the PR, short summary: median latency +1.2% at 512 tokens, 99p within noise. I ran `./scripts/run_kv_tests.sh --profile=ci-canary` and uploaded logs.

jordan: can grab infra check later today. two requests: 1) add a canary rollout plan to the PR (percentages and fallback), 2) confirm no headroom changes needed on the host pools.

leah: ack — adding canary plan now. plan: 5% for 30m, 30% for 1h, 100% w/ auto-failover to previous model. I'll include exact `traffic` YAML. Host pool headroom: none required, this is opt-in header only (no extra GPUs).

maria: security quick q: does this touch any KMS/HSM paths or change token exposure? if not, I can do an expedited review.

leah: no KMS changes. header is opaque string passed through runtime; we do sanitize and never log full header. adding a short security note in PR.

ops-bot: Canary window available Wed 09:00-11:30 PT. Schedule slot reserved by @kevin.

kevin: I can own the canary. I'll coordinate rollback steps and monitor Dashboard -> per-route latency + error spikes. tagging @oncall-runtime for visibility.

sam: thanks. I left one small comment re: KV cache invalidation in low-rt scenarios — trivial code change. will re-approve after that. :+1:

leah: fixed the cache edge case and pushed a tiny test. CI green except flake in e2e that is unrelated.

maria: read the security note, good. +1 from security assuming logs remain scrubbed.

jordan: infra eyes done, nothing blocking. please add the rollout YAML to the PR description (so ops knows exact percentages).

leah: done. PR description updated with rollout YAML and `gh` merge checklist.

sam: giving LGTM from runtime side. :thumbsup:

kevin: all owners present. I'll start the canary tomorrow at 09:05 PT. if anyone wants to join monitoring, ping me.

leah: awesome — thanks everyone. tagging this thread to the PR. will merge after the first canary step if no regressions.

deploy-bot: reminder: when ready, run `./tools/deploy canary --pr 36211 --slot 09:05` and post results.

kevin: deployed first 5% at 09:05, initial telemetry looks clean — no error spikes in first 10m. continuing to 30% at 09:40.

leah: thanks for the hour-by-hour updates. ping back if anything odd.

kevin: rolled to 30% at 09:40, 0.2% uptick in tail but within expected. will move to 100% at 10:45 unless objections.

sam: fine from runtime. no objection.

maria: security still OK.

jordan: infra good.

kevin: rolled to 100% at 10:50. monitoring for 15m.

deploy-bot: PR #36211 merged by leah at 11:06. Deployment complete. :tada:

leah: merging notes saved to the PR. huge thanks all — that was smooth. :rocket:
